name: socratic-code-theory-recovery
description: Recover the "theory" (Naur 1985) of an existing codebase through recursive question refinement before writing documentation. Use on brownfield projects where the spec is missing — produces a Question Tree separating what is answerable from code (with evidence) from what must be asked of the team (routed by role). Phase 1 builds the tree; team answers the OPEN leaves; Phase 2 synthesizes PRD, Cockburn use cases, arc42 architecture, and Nygard ADRs from the answered tree.

name: socratic-coder
description: Teaches you to build by making you do the work, so that you understand what you built. Use when someone asks to build, learn, or debug a project and your job is to build their understanding rather than their app. It refuses monolithic code dumps, teaches in slices of forty lines or fewer with a question after each one, makes the naive version fail on real input before fixing it, and offers a machine-learning step only when that failure actually calls for one. Triggers: learn to code, teach me, build with me, help me understand, I want to learn ML or computer vision, walk me through, why does…

name: socratic-codex
description: Apply evidence discipline to consequential or failure-prone coding work. Use when explicitly invoked for a material boundary, an evidence plateau, drift or premature-closure recovery, or proportionate completion proof. Skip routine deterministic work.

name: socratic-coding-coach
description: Socratic programming mentor that guides the user to solve coding problems themselves instead of handing over answers. Use this skill whenever the user asks to be coached, taught, or mentored on a programming problem, says things like "coach me", "Socratic mode", "don't give me the solution", "help me figure it out myself", "ne mondd meg a megoldást", "vezess rá", "segíts, hogy magam jöjjek rá", or brings a bug, design question, or architecture problem while signalling they want to learn rather than just get a fix. Also use it when the user explicitly invokes the Socratic Coding Coach.

name: socratic-coding-coach
description: A Socratic coding coach that helps you grow as a developer by guiding you to solutions rather than giving them to you. It follows the workflow of requirements gathering, testing, and implementation: outline → tests → code until green.

name: socratic-collab
description: Socratic collaboration on core algorithmic code. Aviv writes the conceptually key functions, Claude writes the rest plus a test notebook. Use when Aviv asks for a plan to implement research or scientific code (a method, algorithm, model or analysis with core math). Include the offer in the plan. Skip if Aviv says "no Socratic". Works together with scientific-python and research-collab.

name: socratic-comprehension
description: A Socratic sparring partner that helps the user understand a difficult text, paper, or concept well enough to explain it in their own words. It does not summarize or ghost-write; it makes the user reconstruct the logic and pushes back on their wording. Use it whenever the user wants to understand, grok, or internalize something for themselves — e.g. "what does this mean", "I want to understand this myself", "help me make this click", "I want to organize this for my own use", "break this down for me", "I want to check that I really got it", or in Japanese 「これどういうこと」「自分のために理解したい」「腹落ちさせたい」「自分用にま…

name: socratic-continue
description: Use when the user invokes /socratic-continue — resume the MOST RECENT /socratic debate with the SAME debaters (all N of them), feed them a new idea/point/objection to chew on, run more clash rounds, and re-translate the outcome. Within the session that ran the debate it resumes the live debaters; in a later session it rebuilds them from the debate log under ~/.socratic/runs/ and says so. A bare /socratic always starts a NEW debate from scratch; use this only to continue an existing one with fresh input.

name: socratic-core
description: Turns vague requests into immediately usable prompts by detecting high-leverage missing information and asking only the necessary follow-up questions.

name: socratic-core
description: 소크라틱 학습 로직. 대화/생성/채점 모드, 스캐폴딩, 힌트 시스템. socratic-loader와 함께 사용.

name: socratic-cs-teacher
description: Use this skill when the user asks for help with programming exercises, logic problems, algorithms, data structures, code with bugs, or any computer science concept. Goal: develop the student's reasoning, not hand them solutions. Target audience: beginner to intermediate, any programming language.

name: socratic-csharp-learning
description: Use Socratic questioning to teach C# through Advent of Code puzzles. Trigger when the user is learning C# as a beginner, working through Advent of Code problems for education, or explicitly asks for Socratic-style C# mentoring. Also trigger when the user says they want to "learn C#" through coding challenges, or mentions using Advent of Code as a learning tool.

name: socratic-ddd-mentor
description: Socratic mentor for the Parking Lot TDD kata, guiding the learner from a naive implementation to a rich Domain-Driven Design model (Eric Evans' tactical patterns). Use when the user is working on the kata, asks "what next?", wants a review of their test or design, asks about value objects, entities, aggregates, invariants, or computing state vs storing it, or invokes /socratic-ddd-mentor. Teaches by asking questions instead of writing the solution.

name: socratic-debate
description: This skill should be used when conducting structured multi-perspective debates to stress-test ideas, evaluate tradeoffs, or reach well-reasoned decisions. Provides the Socratic debate framework with 4 subagent roles.

name: socratic-debate
description: 소크라테스식 3인 팀 토론으로 계획·설계·의사결정을 다각도 검증한다. TeamCreate로 사회자(team lead) + advocate(socratic-partner) + skeptic(design-skeptic) 팀을 구성하고, 라운드 기반 교차 반박으로 합의와 쟁점을 도출한다. "$debate", "/debate", "토론해줘", "소크라테스 토론", "죽음의 토론" 등 사용자가 계획이나 설계에 대해 다각도 검증을 원할 때 사용한다. 단순 질문, 코드 구현, 단일 리뷰에는 사용하지 않는다.
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Agent, TeamCreate, SendMessage, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TaskList, TaskGet

name: socratic-deflect
description: Use when the user ask a existential or philosophical question. Responds to open-ended or philosophical questions with a probing question instead of a direct answer, in a curious, existential tone.

name: socratic-depth
description: Provides question taxonomy, sequencing rules, and framing protocols for assumption-surfacing dialogue. Load this skill whenever Rule 1 applies — before any significant change — and at every Brainstorm Mode entry. Also load when the person appears certain but the basis for that certainty is unstated.

name: socratic-design
description: Use when a planning, design, architecture, or refactor decision is still open. Spike a question a prototype under 30 minutes can settle, restate an L-sized goal in your own words before planning, otherwise ask exactly one dependency-safe question.

name: socratic-design
description: A general-purpose Socratic facilitation framework that guides users from a vague idea to a concrete, decision-locked design document. Use this skill whenever the user says things like "帮我设计 XX"、"我有个想法但还不清楚"、"帮我把需求理清楚"、"帮我想明白"、"help me think this through"、"how should I architect this"、"帮我写个 PRD / RFC / 技术方案 / 设计文档"，especially when key decisions are still fuzzy (acceptance criteria, scope boundaries, role边界, integration points, etc.). The skill runs a 4-layer workflow — Capture Context → internalized brainstorming discipline → Socratic A/B/C/D questioning with dependency ordering → deliverable…

name: socratic-design
description: evidence-first decision-gating for planning, design, architecture, and refactor requests with unresolved requirements, scope, constraints, facts, or tradeoffs. use when the next safe step is to ask exactly one dependency-safe question before proposing a plan or implementation, especially when critical decisions are not yet closed.

name: socratic-design
description: Orchestrates a Socratic design conversation for a software project of any kind (library, CLI, container, service, script, experiment). Reads design/ notes, proposes the next plausible move, surfaces gaps, never fills them. Load when the user invokes /design, asks to start or resume design work, or whenever a gap surfaces during implementation that needs a decision.

name: socratic-design-coaching
description: Coaches the user through a design or build decision by asking questions rather than handing him an answer. Use while working on a game with the user present and directing.

name: socratic-design-review
description: Stress-test a technical design, architecture proposal, RFC, or implementation plan with disciplined Socratic questioning instead of giving answers. Surfaces hidden assumptions, missing evidence, and weak inferences by asking one sharp question at a time, the way a reviewer debugs a teammate's reasoning. Draws on Paul & Elder's nine lenses and six-type taxonomy, CBT-style disputation for "catastrophic" engineering beliefs, and the Zen 参话头 / 起疑情 frame-breaking move. Use when the user asks to grill, challenge, interrogate, or review a design; when a plan feels too smooth and nobody has questione…

name: socratic-dev
description: Guided agentic development loop. Surfaces ambiguities, checks the task is plannable, forces an option choice, and waits for explicit plan approval before any write-capable agent runs.

name: socratic-dev-coach
description: Act as a demanding, supportive Socratic programming mentor. Your primary goal is to build my engineering intuition, debugging speed, and architectural reasoning rather than handing over copy-paste code.

name: socratic-diagnosis
description: Find out exactly which wrong rule a student is using, by treating diagnosis as hypothesis testing over candidate bugs, then repair it. Use when a student makes a mathematical error, gives a right answer for possibly wrong reasons, is stuck, or when grilling a topic to find hidden misconceptions. Includes a seeded catalogue of common algebra, calculus, linear algebra and ODE bugs, a probe taxonomy for designing discriminating questions, and a repair protocol that survives relapse.

name: socratic-dialogue
description: 把任何文章、产品、观点、道理，写成苏格拉底对话体（一个信徒兴奋陈词，苏格拉底层层追问，最后反转留白）。仅在用户明确要"对话体/苏格拉底式"时触发——比如"把这个写成苏格拉底对话""用对话体写""苏格拉底式拆解 X""仿柏拉图对话录讲讲这个观点""让苏格拉底和某人辩一辩 X"。普通写文章、普通润色不要触发。

name: socratic-dialogue
description: Reasoning rigor and anti-sycophancy guard for high-stakes decisions. Refuses to answer until the question is anchored to operational definitions, cross-examined against prior commitments, and validated by an internal faithfulness check. For high-stakes, ambiguous, or strategically loaded reasoning.

name: socratic-dialogue
description: Socratic Dialogue is a reasoning skill that replaces the default "vending machine" interaction with a structured seminar model. The agent refuses to deliver an answer until the question is anchored to operational definitions, cross-examined against prior commitments, and validated by an internal faithfulness check. It is built for high-stakes, ambiguous, or strategically loaded reasoning — the situations where a confident wrong answer costs more than a slow one. Do not apply it as a global conversational style; activation must match one of the explicit `use_when` cases below.

name: socratic-dialogue
description: Guide human-AI conversations with lightweight Socratic questioning and guided discovery. Use when the user explicitly asks for 苏格拉底式提问, 反问我, 帮我想清楚, challenge my assumptions, decision clarification, guided reflection, learning through questions, or help thinking something through. Also use after a Socratic or reflective dialogue when the user asks 帮我总结, 总结一下, summarize this conversation, or extract conclusions, to gather scattered conclusions from the dialogue. Trigger narrowly and implicitly only for reflective dialogue and reflective-summary requests. Do not use for direct execution, coding,…

name: socratic-dialogue
description: Use when any command in this plugin is mid-conversation with a trainee, and whenever a trainee pushes back on being asked things ("stop asking me questions", "just tell me the answer", "I don't know", "can you just explain it", "I'm stuck"). Governs how a single turn works — one question per turn, the hint ladder, the stop conditions, and the difference between refusing a solution and refusing to teach — never the subject matter of the command that loaded it and never the contents of the document that command writes. Loaded by every command in the plugin rather than triggered on a topic of it…

name: socratic-dialogue
description: Explain a concept as a Socratic dialogue between a curious learner (Q) and an expert (A), where the learner keeps pushing with "but why" until the expert's underlying tacit reasoning surfaces -- rather than presenting the conclusion directly. Use whenever the user asks for "Socratic method", "Q&A style", "dialogue format", or wants to see the reasoning process behind a conclusion rather than just the conclusion itself. Especially effective for surfacing the tacit, hard-to-articulate judgment that experts use but rarely write down explicitly.

name: socratic-dialogue-facilitation
description: Lead philosophical inquiry through structured questioning, elicit assumptions, expose contradictions, and guide interlocutors toward deeper understanding
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

name: socratic-discovery
description: Optional communication lens for skeptical stakeholders — not a design→plan→RFC pipeline. Use when assumptions need shared discovery. See project-process for the work pipeline.

name: socratic-discovery
description: Use when interviewing someone to find out what they really need. Asks one plain-language question at a time, tests assumptions, and never fills in answers for them.

name: socratic-discuss
description: 苏格拉底式讨论伴侣，通过结构化对话帮助深度内化知识。用于：(1) 拿到一段内容（视频稿/文章/书本/课程材料）后想要讨论和理解，(2) 测试一个观点的稳固性，(3) 通过教学来验证掌握程度，(4) 将新知识与已有知识库建立连接，(5) 将想法转化为可执行的行动。支持五种讨论模式和自适应深度。触发词包括"讨论""解释""帮我理解""聊聊""对话""socratic""苏格拉底"等。

name: socratic-discussion
description: Conducts Socratic research discussions to help users critically examine their insights, methods, and claims. Integrates with 7 checker dimensions for targeted questioning. Use this skill when the user wants to discuss or analyze their research.

name: socratic-discussion
description: Use before drafting or when claims need stress-testing. Not suitable when: Do not answer by inventing research content; ask questions and record uncertainties. File changes: no. Default output: notes/socratic_discussion.md.

name: socratic-doc
description: A specialized mentor skill utilizing the Socratic Method for deeply teaching new concepts. Triggers whenever the user says 'I want to learn...', 'Explain this using Socratic...', or asks to understand a tough concept. The AI must never give direct answers, and it automatically documents the user's epiphanies/learnings into a neatly formatted Markdown study sheet.

name: socratic-drill
description: Socratic drilling — it asks, you answer, it pushes back. Does NOT give you the answer until you've earned it. Use when the user says "drill me on", "quiz me", "socratic", "test me on [subject]", or wants to study actively.

name: socratic-drill
description: Drills the user on a framework with application-level scenario questions. Inspired by mattpocock/skills/grill-me. Tracks coverage in-session, evaluates answers against framework guidance, never reproduces normative standard text.

name: socratic-drill
description: 苏格拉底式追问训练——我问，你答，我追问。在你真正掌握之前绝不给你答案。 当用户说"训练我""提问我""苏格拉底式""测试我的[科目]"或想进行主动学习时使用。

name: socratic-drill
description: Socratic 连珠炮追问训练（S3+S4）。

name: socratic-drill
description: 中文触发词: 法律学习;案例分析;法条学习。 Socratic drilling — it asks, you answer, it pushes back. Does NOT give you the answer until you've earned it. Use when the user says "drill me on", "quiz me", "socratic", "test me on [subject]", or wants to study actively.

name: socratic-drill-bossmann007
description: Socratic drilling — it asks, you answer, it pushes back. Does NOT give you the answer until you've earned it. Use when the user says "drill me on", "quiz me", "socratic", "test me on [subject]", or wants to study actively.

description: Socratic drilling — it asks, you answer, it pushes back. Does NOT give you the answer until you've earned it. Use when the user says "drill me on", "quiz me", "socratic", "test me on [subject]", or wants to study actively.

Use whenever the user explicitly asks to be questioned, pressure-tested, or grilled about a plan or design ("question this", "grill me on this", "let's discuss in depth", "technical decision:" as a prefix). Also trigger proactively, after asking for confirmation, when the user is about to commit to a non-trivial architectural, infrastructure, security, or stack decision, especially if the…

name: socratic-duel

name: socratic-duel-run
description: Run Socratic Duel through two participant subagents while the launcher only coordinates and reports.

name: socratic-elenchus
description: Socratic dialogue (elenchus) as in Plato's Socratic dialogues. Finds the concept an idea stands on, asks "what is X?", gets the user's agreement to premises one short question at a time, and shows where those premises contradict the definition so the user revises it; each revision is a new idea the user gives birth to. Usually ends in aporia (knowing what you don't know). Gives no advice or ideas of its own. Use when the user asks for the Socratic method or Socratic dialogue itself, elenchus, or to test whether they really know what they mean (e.g. "socratic dialogue", "elenchus", "what do I…

name: socratic-elenchus
description: 用苏格拉底式反诘（elenchus）陪用户把模糊的立场、定义、论证逼成站得住或明确站不住的东西：澄清定义、检验反例、暴露矛盾、促成修订，以更清楚的定义、暴露的前提、有支撑的判断或精确的未解问题收束。当用户说「帮我理清楚」「我有点纠结」「这个说法站不站得住」，或说 "help me think this through" "ask me Socratically"，或带来模糊的判断、概念、待写的论证时使用。不用于心理治疗、法律医疗建议、有标准答案的知识点辅导。

name: socratic-elicitation
description: Use when the user recognizes something they cannot yet explain, or their examples and reactions suggest an intuition worth developing together. Offer reflections that help them examine and articulate their thinking, letting their response change the conversation.

name: socratic-elicitation
description: Asks Socratic questions, one at a time, to surface missing information, unstated assumptions, and open tradeoffs before work begins, or to stress-test a plan the user holds. Use when the user says "ask me questions first", "what am I missing", "poke holes in this", or "challenge this plan", or when a request is too vague to start. Ends with a requirements or challenge summary.

name: socratic-elicitation
description: Clarifies material gaps in a requirement before planning. Use when scope, actors, success criteria, safety constraints, or edge cases remain unclear after codebase research.

name: socratic-essay
description: 苏格拉底式文章编写。当用户以"一个问题/一个观点"开始、希望与模型通过苏格拉底式问答互相探讨、达成共识后由模型将思辨过程写成项目文章并供其审查时使用。触发词如"苏格拉底"、"讨论一个问题"、"帮我写一篇文章"、"先聊一聊再写"等。

name: socratic-explainer
description: 当用户请求"讲解/教我/帮我理解"某个概念、理论或抽象思想时使用；用苏格拉底式对话（提问引导+单一类比+反思追问）产出循序渐进、引导用户自行抵达清晰的对话式讲解；不适用于求快速定义、安装配置、排错或事实速查。触发词：讲解、教我、帮我理解、像苏格拉底

name: socratic-first-principles
description: Use for complex, assumption-heavy problems. Strips bias and unverified claims to rebuild solutions from fundamental, verified truths.

name: socratic-gate
description: Socratic questioning protocol + user communication. MANDATORY for complex requests, new features, or unclear requirements. Includes progress reporting and error handling. (Formerly `brainstorming`.)

name: socratic-grill
description: Use this skill as a workplace Socratic questioning mentor. It helps PMs, engineers, QA, SRE, data, ops, and managers clarify problems, review plans, challenge assumptions, expose risks, resolve disagreements, and converge on actionable consensus through one-question-at-a-time grilling. Trigger whenever the user wants to think something through, review or challenge a plan, or resolve a disagreement — e.g. 帮我想清楚、追问我、 苏格拉底式提问、帮我审一下、这个方案有没有问题、我在纠结、帮我复盘、 帮我决策、找找漏洞。Also trigger for: PRD or tech-design review, requirement clarification, pre-launch risk check, retrospective, cross-team alignment. Do…

name: socratic-grilling
description: Grill the user to build a shared mental model.

name: socratic-grilling-patterns
description: Fornece algoritmo de árvore de decisão e protocolo de registro concorrente (Grill-with-Docs) para conduzir interrogatório socrático estruturado via ask_questions, mapeando a fronteira ativa de incerteza até decisões arquiteturais documentadas. Use quando um requisito, decisão arquitetural ou trade-off técnico permanecer ambíguo após a primeira rodada de clarificação. Não use para coleta trivial de dados objetivos — usar structured-intake-patterns.

name: socratic-ground-up
description: Guides the learner to understand an unfamiliar topic from absolute zero through Socratic questioning, instead of explaining it to them. First builds a complete dependency graph of every concept involved and shows it as a map, then walks the learner through it with very small, easy questions (often obvious ones) so they reason out each idea themselves, brick by brick, while the map recolours to show what is done and what is left. Use this whenever the user wants to learn by working it out, asks to be guided or quizzed into understanding, says things like "don't just tell me, guide me", "make m…

name: socratic-gtm-strategist
description: Review an AI startup's go-to-market strategy through eight Socratic phases: customer frequency, alternatives, adoption, market focus, value delivery, model/context control, pricing, and integrations. Use for founder strategy reviews, evidence gaps, falsifiable experiments, and draft GTM artifacts.

name: socratic-homework
description: Hint-first homework help; refuse concealment.

name: socratic-idea-giant
description: Use this skill whenever the user shares a raw idea, hypothesis, startup concept, creative project, business direction, or any thought they want to think through more deeply. Activate automatically when phrases like "I have an idea", "what do you think about", "I'm thinking of", "помоги разобрать идею", "разгони идею", "давай исследуем", "концепция такая" appear — even if the user doesn't explicitly ask for Socratic questioning or deep analysis. Do not wait for a formal request. This skill also applies when the user wants to pressure-test an assumption, explore a new direction, or turn a vague…

name: socratic-ideation
description: 命题淬炼协议：命题的四个面、三个质询角色的分工、质疑的五条出路、什么时候必须问人、以及追问何时该停。当任务涉及把一个模糊的写作意向变成可被反驳的命题、多模型互相追问、判断某条命题站不站得住、决定各条论证线该分多少检索力度与篇幅、或在证据齐备后复核原命题是否仍成立时使用。

name: socratic-inquiry
description: 苏格拉底式问诊提示语原文。用户说不清自己到底想问什么、问题一团乱、想先把问题问清楚再动手时使用。触发词包括 苏格拉底、苏格拉底式提问、帮我问诊、帮我理清问题、我不知道该问什么、先别给建议、我到底想问什么。一次只问一个问题，最多六问，最后产出一个真正值得回答的新问题。问完要出三版方案，用 align-then-three。要直接核查问题定义并指出更值得解决的问题，用 challenge-the-question。

name: socratic-inquiry
description: Use Socratic questioning to reach shared understanding of a project and its goal. Use when the user wants assumptions examined, terms clarified, reasoning tested, contradictions exposed, or project intent discovered without jumping directly to solutions.

name: socratic-inquiry
description: Use when the user wants to examine their own judgment or confusion through Socratic dialogue, rigorous questioning, reasons, and counterexamples. 用于用户主动提出“苏格拉底式追问”“严格质询”“检验我的逻辑”或希望把自己的判断、困惑想清楚。 不用于简单事实查找、哲学人物简介、单纯安慰或操控别人认输。

name: socratic-inquiry
description: Use one-question-at-a-time Socratic dialogue to clarify dilemmas, emotional loops, hidden assumptions, conflicting goals, and self-understanding. Use when the user wants to think through a problem rather than receive an immediate solution.

name: socratic-inquiry
description: 苏格拉底式问诊。通过最多 6 个层层递进的问题，帮你找到真正值得回答的问题。用于：表达困惑、卡在某个问题里、感觉自己在问错问题时。

name: socratic-inquiry
description: Use when a request turns on an abstract quality word — reliable, scalable, secure, robust, maintainable, clean, fast, simple, better, production-ready — and nobody has said what would count as achieving it, so acting would mean deciding for yourself what the word means. Also use when a cause is asserted rather than demonstrated ("the bug is X, go fix X"), or when a question presupposes its own answer. Takes dates, numbers, units, ranks, routes, sequences and battle anecdotes. Family members' service goes to sp-family-offices.

name: sp-museum-specimens
description: Use when a claim concerns natural-history specimens collected by T.R., his sons or his expeditions, or the museum records of those expeditions: the Smithsonian (National Museum of Natural History, Smithsonian Institution Archives), the American Museum of Natural History, Harvard's Museum of Comparative Zoology, and others. Takes claims about which museum received specimens, how many, catalog numbers, game lists, expedition sponsorship and records, and whether a specimen is on exhibit.

name: sp-myths
description: Specialist for myths, legends and misattributions about T.R.: apocryphal stories, teddy bear story variants, fake or misattributed quotes, 'first president to' legends, things he supposedly coined or invented, the San Juan Hill and round-robin myths, deathbed and 'famous last words' lines, and anecdotes that sound too good. Use when copy repeats a well-known story, a quote-poster line, a 'first' or 'coined', or a 'legend has it'. Checks the Library's misquotes and fake-quotes pages first; those pages are not sources.

name: sp-natural-history
description: Specialist for Theodore Roosevelt as naturalist and hunter: boyhood collecting and the Roosevelt Museum of Natural History, bird lists, species and subspecies named for or by him, hunting trips and game lists (the West, Africa, South America), which institution sponsored a collecting trip, the Boone and Crockett Club, and the nature-faker controversy. Use for any claim about animals he observed, shot, collected or wrote about. Museum catalog record lookups go to sp-museum-specimens.

name: sp-navy-rough-riders
description: Specialist for Theodore Roosevelt as Assistant Secretary of the Navy, 1897-1898, and in the Rough Riders (First U.S. Volunteer Cavalry): naval preparedness, the Maine, the cable to Dewey, his resignation, raising and training the regiment, the move to Cuba and the landing, Las Guasimas, Kettle Hill and the San Juan Heights, the siege of Santiago, the round-robin letter, Montauk, his book The Rough Riders, and later honors for the 1898 action. Use for any claim about T.R. at the Navy Department or in the Spanish-American War.

name: sp-northern-plains-indigenous
description: FLAGS AND ROUTING ONLY. Specialist for any claim touching Northern Plains Indigenous history in T.R.'s era and places: the Mandan, Hidatsa and Arikara (MHA Nation), Lakota, Dakota, Nakota, Assiniboine, Crow, Cheyenne, Chippewa and other nations; reservations, agencies, treaties, land cessions and allotment; Indigenous presence in the Badlands; and T.R.'s words or policies about Native peoples. Gathers respectful, authoritative sources and stops. Every claim routes to the Library's human reviewers and is never closed by the panel.

description: You bridge the Notion database with the local evaluation pipeline. **Notion is the source of truth.** The primary flow is: pull → evaluate → fix → push back to Notion. Local files are working copies, not deliverables.

name: sp-nps-sites
description: Use when a claim cites, or concerns the records of, a National Park Service unit tied to T.R.: Sagamore Hill NHS, Theodore Roosevelt Birthplace NHS, Theodore Roosevelt Inaugural NHS, Theodore Roosevelt National Park, Theodore Roosevelt Island, or the NPS museum collections, historic resource studies, administrative histories, NPS 'people' pages and the NPS History Collection. Takes claims sourced to nps.gov, and claims about the houses, rooms, objects and history of these sites.

name: sp-objects
description: Use for claims about specific physical objects connected with T.R.: who owns or holds an artifact, its provenance and chain of ownership, catalog records, original versus replica or reproduction, loans versus permanent collection, and specific firearms, swords, saddles, chaps, furniture, books, clothing, the Medal of Honor, the Nobel medal and other artifacts. Covers how objects are described and credited in exhibits and captions.

name: sp-officeholder-sequences
description: Specialist for who held an office, in what order, and for how long — presidents, cabinet members, governors, commanders and diplomats around Theodore Roosevelt. Use for "before him," "succeeded," "preceded," tenure dates, election results, and any cause-and-effect chain that depends on what happened first.

name: sp-on-this-day
description: Specialist for 'On This Day' history about Theodore Roosevelt: whether an event really happened on a given month and day, what happened on a date, anniversary counts ('120 years ago today'), and the date traps that make OTD posts wrong. Use for every #OTD draft, anniversary post, holiday or birthday page, and any 'today in history' claim.

name: sp-open-range-west
description: Specialist for the open-range cattle West of the 1880s around T.R.'s ranching: ranching economics and investment, herd sizes and prices, the winter of 1886-87 and its losses, stock growers' associations, brands and roundups, the Northern Pacific Railroad and shipping, vigilance and 'stranglers', frontier towns, and territorial status and boundaries of Dakota and Montana. Use for context claims about the cattle business or the frontier that are not about T.R.'s own actions.

name: sp-period-newspapers
description: Use when a claim's best evidence is a newspaper or magazine of T.R.'s lifetime: what a paper reported, when, and in what words; dates of events known mainly from press reports; speech texts as printed in the press; and contemporary reactions. Takes claims citing a named period paper, Chronicling America, a state digital newspaper program, or a licensed newspaper archive, and claims of the form 'newspapers reported' or 'the press called him.'

name: sp-period-visuals
description: Specialist for whether a picture of T.R.'s world looks right for its time and place — illustrations, AI-generated images, reenactment photos, video, animation, 3D reconstructions and exhibit graphics. Checks flags and star counts, uniforms and insignia, firearms, clothing, vehicles and technology, buildings, and what the landscape looked like then. Also enforces the Library's rule that image generators never depict identifiable buildings. Use before any new visual of a historical scene is published.

name: sp-photo-id
description: Specialist for identifying historical images of Theodore Roosevelt's world — who is pictured, when and where, the photographer or artist, the credit line — and for checking captions and alt text against the holding institution's catalog record. Use for any image caption, alt text, photo credit or "pictured here" claim.

name: spec-00-prd
description: Functional PRD grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-00. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to grill the user one question at a time and draft spec-00-functional-prd.md with zero implementation detail. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-00-scope-split
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-00 [path]、/spec-run（帶來新需求時），或說「評估需求大小」「這個需求要不要切」「幫我切分需求」「拆成幾個模組」時使用。在 spec-01 之前評估一份新需求的大小：未超過門檻就以單一模組繼續；超過門檻就自動決定切分方案並落盤，只有不確定之處會改變下一個要跑的模組範圍時才停下來問，其餘疑點放進待人檢視清單、不阻擋流程。之後 spec-01 一次只掃一個模組。

name: spec-009-d1-matematica
description: Suite TDD para D1 (Raciocinio Matematico Formal) do CORA-Eval. 8 CTs: Pitagoras, Gauss, Fatorial, Fibonacci, Primos, MDC, Trigonometria, Derivada. Validacao via TDD com pytest. Use quando precisar validar raciocinio matematico formal do ecossistema OpenCode no dominio da matematica pura.

name: spec-01-discovery-bootstrap
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-01 [path]、/spec-run，或說「冷啟動」「掃需求」「幫我分析這個需求」時使用。對新需求靜態掃描：鎖定核心業務切片、抽取行為矩陣與 DBML 草稿、初始化術語表、套用既有組織慣例、以高風險探測清單找盲點並轉成 MCQ 佇列。純掃描器角色，唯一允許問的是「這屬於哪個模組」。新需求必須先經 spec-00 確認切分方案，本階段一次只掃方案中的一個模組。

name: spec-01-domain-model
description: Domain-model grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-01. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to shape the business domain with Object Modeling in Color from the spec-00 PRD. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-010-d2-fisica
description: Suite TDD para D2 (Modelagem de Sistemas Fisicos) do CORA-Eval. 8 CTs: MRU, Queda Livre, Conservacao de Energia, Analise Dimensional, Hooke, Pendulo, Conservacao de Momento, Gases. Use quando precisar validar modelagem de sistemas fisicos.

name: spec-011-d9-metodologia
description: Suite TDD para D9 (Desenho Experimental e Metodologia) do CORA-Eval. 8 CTs: ANOVA, Teste t, Randomizacao, Cohen's d, Poder estatistico, Shapiro-Wilk, Propagacao de erros, Delineamento fatorial 2^3. Use quando precisar validar metodologia experimental.

name: spec-012-d3-estatistica
description: Suite TDD para D3 (Raciocinio Estatistico) do CORA-Eval. 9 testes em niveis N2-N3: Teste t (2), ANOVA, Regressao Linear, Correlacao de Pearson, Bootstrap, MCMC, PCA, Correcao Multiplas Comparacoes. 11 funcoes implementadas. Validacao via TDD com dados sinteticos seed 42.

name: spec-013-d11-longhorizon
description: Suite TDD para D11 (Raciocinio de Longo Horizonte em DAG) do CORA-Eval. 150 CTs em 5 dominios (Logica, Matematica, Planejamento, Fluxo de Codigo, Cientifico) x 4 niveis (N1-N4). Validacao via pytest com engine DAG propria. Use quando precisar validar raciocinio de longo horizonte com propagacao em grafos aciclicos dirigidos.

name: spec-013-d4-quimica
description: Suite TDD para D4 (Raciocinio Quimico) do CORA-Eval. 3 CTs em nivel N1: Balanceamento, Massa Molar, Concentracao. Validacao via TDD com massas atomicas IUPAC 2021. Use quando precisar validar raciocinio quimico fundamental do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-014-d5-biologia
description: Suite TDD para D5 (Raciocinio Biologico) do CORA-Eval. 3 CTs em nivel N1: Transcricao, Traducao, GC Content. Validacao via TDD com codigo genetico padrao. Use quando precisar validar raciocinio biologico molecular do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-015-d6-geociencias
description: Suite TDD para D6 (Raciocinio em Geociencias) do CORA-Eval. 3 CTs em nivel N1: Rochas, Temperatura, Atmosfera. Validacao via TDD com classificacao real de rochas e camadas atmosfericas. Use quando precisar validar raciocinio em geociencias do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-016-d7-codigo
description: Suite TDD para D7 (Verificacao de Codigo) do CORA-Eval. 5 CTs em nivel N3: Syntax, Logic, Types, Complexity, Security, Coverage. Validacao via TDD com pytest sobre codigo real de suites anteriores. Use quando precisar validar verificacao de codigo fonte do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-017-d8-literatura
description: Suite TDD para D8 (Revisao Sistematica de Literatura) do CORA-Eval. 3 CTs em nivel N1: Claims, Citations, Classification. Validacao via TDD com corpus de 7 artigos cientificos reais. Use quando precisar validar extracao e classificacao de literatura academica do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-018-d10-interdisciplinar
description: Suite TDD para D10 (Sintese Interdisciplinar) do CORA-Eval. 3 CTs em nivel N4: Nelson (Geometria Diferencial), GAT (Teoria de Gauge), Continuity (Continuidade Estocastica). Validacao via TDD com implementacoes baseadas em Farinelli arXiv:0910.1671. Use quando precisar validar sintese interdisciplinar do ecossistema OpenCode.

name: spec-02-architecture
description: Architecture grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-02, including conditional spec-02x sidecars. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to define layering, boundaries, persistence shape, and deployment on the canonical stack. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-02-interactive-clarify
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-02 [MODULE_ID]、/spec-run，或說「釐清」「回答問題」「繼續問我」時使用。把 .specengine/sdd/ 佇列裡的未決問題以白話選擇題分組詢問使用者（優先用 AskUserQuestion 工具），每題答完立即把決策寫回行為矩陣、刻意不做清單或 .specengine/spec/。未答的題一律掛起為 PARKED。

name: spec-03-formalize-gherkin
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-03 [MODULE_ID]、/spec-run，或說「形式化」「產生 feature 檔」「寫 Gherkin」時使用。把已釐清並通過流程對齊的模組矩陣形式化為 Gherkin，逐列核對 Examples 可由矩陣推導，產出 .specengine/spec/features/*.feature，並以 feature-lint.js 實際驗證。

name: spec-03-implementation-guidance
description: Implementation-guidance grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-03. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to convert architecture into concrete coding conventions, error model, and test posture. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-04-generate-test-stub
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-04 [MODULE_ID]、/spec-run，或說「產生測試骨架」「寫測試 stub」時使用。為已形式化的 Feature 檔，依 architecture-manifest.md 宣告的 BDD 框架、目錄與 Binding Layer，產出確定性紅燈的 Step Definitions、Driver 介面與 fixture 接線。

name: spec-04-user-interface
description: User-interface grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-04. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to define screens, navigation, interaction states, and mockup scaffolding. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-05-app-use-cases
description: App use-case grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-05. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to define application-layer orchestrators with inputs, outputs, errors, and authorization rules. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-05-coder-implement
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-05 [MODULE_ID]、/spec-run，或說「開始實作」「寫代碼」「紅轉綠」時使用。把 spec-04 產出的紅燈測試改為綠燈：先實作 Driver 介面接產品碼，再寫產品碼。以 spec-guard.js 凍結規格、Step 句型與 Driver 介面；完工後 lock。

name: spec-06-drift-audit
description: 當使用者輸入 /spec-06，或說「巡檢」「規格漂移」「檢查跟現實有沒有脫鉤」時使用。比對 .specengine/spec/erm.dbml 與實際資料庫 Schema、比對 Rule 覆蓋率與測試結果，找出漂移並推入佇列。純唯讀巡檢，不自動修正任一邊。不屬於 spec-run 串接範圍。

name: spec-06-execution-plan
description: Execution-plan grilling workflow for dm-spec-creation spec-06. Agent-only sub-skill invoked by the dm-spec-creation orchestrator to produce the agent-executable inside-out Phase plan consumed by dm-spec-execution. Do not invoke directly; invoke dm-spec-creation instead.

name: spec-1-intake
description: Transform an idea or request into a structured intake for a specification workflow. Now includes workflow recommendation (plan vs. spec-1-intake→spec-5-revise vs. hybrid).

name: spec-1-specify
description: Создаёт спецификацию изменения ДО кода: каталог .specs/<id>-<slug>/ с proposal.md (зачем и что) и spec.md (требования + сценарии + критерии приёмки). Задаёт уточняющие вопросы вместо молчаливых догадок. Используй, когда пользователь просит «составь спеку», «спецификация», «сделай ТЗ», «опиши требования к фиче», начинает новую фичу или значимое изменение, требования неоднозначны или задача затрагивает несколько модулей. Первый шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-2-draft
description: Draft a structured implementation specification from a validated intake.

name: spec-2-plan
description: Создаёт технический план plan.md для изменения с готовой спекой: подход, решения с обоснованием и отвергнутыми альтернативами, затрагиваемый код, данные и контракты, риски. Отвечает «как», не трогая «что» из спеки. Используй после spec-1-specify, когда пользователь просит «составь план», «техплан», «как будем реализовывать», «продумай подход к реализации». Второй шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-2nd-opinion
description: Use when the user says "spec-2nd-opinion", or a plan/design/ordering has been settled by grill or discussion (pre-implementation) and the user wants an independent audit before committing to it. Dispatches ONE read-only auditor subagent to verify the plan's claims against the codebase; the final plan is presented only when orchestrator and auditor agree.

name: spec-3-audit
description: Audit a draft specification for ambiguity, missing constraints, risks, and implementation readiness.

name: spec-3-tasks
description: Разбивает согласованную спеку и план изменения на исполняемые задачи в tasks.md: фазы, трассировка [R#] к требованиям, параллельные [P], критерий проверки у каждой задачи, самодостаточные формулировки. Используй после spec-2-plan, когда пользователь просит «разбей на задачи», «составь список задач», «декомпозиция», «чеклист имплементации». Третий шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-3rd-opinion
description: Use when the user says "spec-3rd-opinion", or a settled plan needs maximum pre-commit scrutiny — same flow as spec-2nd-opinion plus a SECOND concurrent auditor on an adversarial brief (assume the plan flawed, hunt what the standard lens misses). The final plan is presented only when ALL THREE agree: orchestrator + standard auditor + adversarial auditor.

name: spec-4-challenge
description: Challenge a specification by identifying weak assumptions, alternatives, hidden risks, and unnecessary complexity.

name: spec-4-implement
description: Исполняет tasks.md готового изменения: задачи по порядку зависимостей, отметка чекбоксов, проверка критерия после каждой задачи, мелкие коммиты, остановка на контрольных точках. При расхождении кода со спекой — спека обновляется первой. Используй, когда пользователь просит «реализуй по задачам», «выполни tasks.md», «продолжай имплементацию», «сделай задачу T3». Четвёртый шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-5-revise
description: Revise a specification after audit or challenge feedback and produce an implementation-ready version.

name: spec-5-verify
description: Сверяет код готового изменения со спекой: каждое требование R# классифицируется как выполнено/частично/противоречит/сверх спеки, сценарии и критерии приёмки прогоняются, выдаётся отчёт-вердикт «готово к закрытию или нужны правки». Используй после spec-4-implement, когда пользователь просит «проверь по спеке», «сверь код со спекой», «верификация», «готово ли к закрытию». Пятый шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-6-archive
description: Закрывает изменение sdd: вливает дельты spec.md в накопительную спеку системы .specs/_system/<домен>.md, перемещает каталог изменения в .specs/archive/ с датой, делает финальный коммит. Используй, когда пользователь просит «закрой изменение», «заархивируй спеку», «закрой фичу», после вердикта «готов к закрытию» от spec-5-verify. Финальный шаг цикла sdd: specify → plan → tasks → implement → verify → archive.

name: spec-a-html
description: Toma un spec de producto con historias de usuario y genera el HTML de cada vista o flujo, la fuente de verdad visual que DEV construye, sobre un design system liviano (design/tokens.css y design/components.css) que busca en el repositorio de diseño o crea si no existe. También edita una vista existente cuando cambia el diseño. Úsala siempre que alguien de producto o diseño quiera pasar un spec, una épica o unas historias a pantallas, mockups, prototipos o HTML, aunque no diga "HTML" - "arma las pantallas de este spec", "haz el mockup de la épica de alertas", "dibuja la vista de listado", "gen…

name: spec-a-tickets
description: Convierte un spec de producto con historias de usuario en tickets listos para construir, una story por historia, con la historia COMO, QUIERO, PARA, los escenarios del spec copiados tal cual como criterios de aceptación, pruebas E2E, enlace a la vista de diseño, casos borde y preguntas abiertas. Los publica en el tracker del proyecto (Linear, GitHub, GitLab u otro) o, si no hay tracker, como un archivo markdown por ticket en specs/<épica>/tickets/. Úsala siempre que producto quiera pasar un spec, una épica o unas historias a tickets, issues o stories, aunque no lo diga así - "crea los tickets…

name: spec-a23
description: Workflow de spec-driven development para Claude Code, focado em VELOCIDADE e BAIXO CUSTO de tokens, mas com regras pesadas de SEGURANÇA, qualidade, review e testes. Cria estrutura completa de implementação em pastas .md (resumo, visão geral, research, fases) na pasta `implementacao/<slug>/` do projeto, pré-cria todas as fases e subfases de uma vez para discussão única, executa cada subfase via subagent em modelo padrão e effort padrão e VALIDA tudo (segurança, qualidade, testes, correções) com o modelo da sessão. Use sempre que o usuário falar sobre planejar, implementar, especificar, criar i…

name: spec-abandon
description: Closes the spec GitHub Issue and optionally closes its linked task issues. Use when a feature is cancelled or no longer being pursued.

name: spec-absorb
description: Transform an existing document into a spec-coach spec artifact. Point this skill at any source document (a design, a requirements list, old notes, output from another tool) and reshape it into specs/NNN-slug/spec.md — without rewriting it from scratch.

name: spec-abstract
description: 从完整权利要求书生成简洁的中国专利摘要。在完成专利申请并需要提交摘要时使用。

name: spec-accept
description: Run user acceptance testing against spec requirements
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, Agent, AskUserQuestion

name: spec-acceptance
description: 定义验收 acceptance：编写可测量的 acceptance.md 成功标准。

name: spec-acceptance
description: Explicit activation only. Internal final step of a user-invoked spec-workflow. Select only after the active branch hands off, or when the user explicitly names spec-acceptance and thereby opts into the plugin; otherwise do not select.

name: spec-acceptance-criteria
description: Write clear, testable acceptance criteria using BDD Given/When/Then format.

name: spec-acceptance-harness
description: Turn Specification Kit (Spec Kit) feature specifications or product requirements into executable feature acceptance coverage using Gherkin feature files, Playwright browser tests, and a story matrix that maps stories to required backend or service routes. Use when a project needs durable behavior traceability from specification to implementation proof.

name: spec-acceptance-protocol
description: 在 Spec 交付人工验收前执行真实 API E2E 门禁、记录可复核证据、生成逐步人工验收案例并评估准备度；不适用于仅需单元测试或静态审查的任务。

name: spec-acceptance-review
description: 审查六部分 Spec 是否具备明确来源、清晰边界和可验证的验收条件，能否作为个人研发工作台的受控执行合同。适用于需求初稿、修订稿和确认前复验；不替代业务确认、结构解析或产品验收。

name: spec-accessibility-ux
description: WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility rules, inclusive design, visual contrast, keyboard navigation focus management, and semantic tree definitions.

name: spec-action
description: /vs·/isok 결정 후 구현 명세(파일별 변경) + TaskCreate 자동 등록 + 테스트 시나리오 생성. 완료 후 /spec-build → /spec-up 파이프라인으로 연결. spec-define 없이 결정된 소규모 변경에 적용.

name: spec-ad
description: Make a premium spec ad, brand film or product reveal in EffectCraft as ONE continuous camera move through a 2.5D world (flat layers placed at real depths) - stations timed on a beat grid that picture and sound share, a camera that glides and whips without ever stopping dead, depth of field on the station plane, motion blur that only streaks the fast moves, music and sound effects from SoundCraft whose whooshes peak on the camera's speed peaks - then 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5 from the same scene, with a half-resolution preview before the finals. Use it when the user asks for a spec ad, brand fil…

name: spec-add
description: Add specs, conventions, constraints, or learnings to project guidelines interactively or automatically
allowed_tools: request_user_input, Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

name: spec-add-member
description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "adopt an existing crate as a workspace member", "add a member to a workspace", "promote a single-crate project to a workspace", "migrate a single-crate spec into a workspace", "make this crate the first member of a workspace", "fold an existing spec into crates/", or "move a validated crate under a rust-workspace root". Adopts a *validated* single-crate spec (library-api / firmware-layered / audio-plugin) into a `crates/<member>/` slot under a `rust-workspace` root, preserving requirement / decision / open-question ids by moving the tree wholes…
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep

name: spec-add-requirement
description: Add or materially change product requirements in spec/ while keeping human-readable markdown and machine-readable YAML (prd.spec.yaml, stories.spec.yaml) aligned, plus digest and changelog.

name: spec-adhere
description: Audit a Rust crate's adherence to its Stellar protocol spec (spec-driven, walks every normative claim)

name: spec-adopt
description: Brings an existing project's VISION, FUNCTIONAL and TECHNICAL documents under the spec system once, as one reviewable PR that changes no meaning - ids, serves and Realises lines, one terms table per level, records moved out of the contracts, LOG.md, and [spec] in factory/config.toml - and lists for the human everything that would change meaning. Also for a flat project that gains subsystems. Use when the human says "/spec-adopt", when spec-lint reports a project as not adopted and the human wants it fixed, or when a decided split adds a subsystem.

name: spec-adopt
description: Bringing a project's existing documents — a specification, requirements, design notes — into the specification's nodes, and its code and tests under the checks. Use when a project takes up this method with documents or code it already has.

name: spec-adopt
description: Write the first spec for a capability by describing what the code does today: statements pinned as written, evidence mapped from existing tests, anomalies recorded, nothing fixed. Use when the user wants to adopt a capability, bring existing code under spec, or invokes /spec-adopt on a capability named in specs/registry.yaml.

name: spec-adopt-context
description: Brings context that already exists — README, ADRs, wiki, tickets, specs from another tool — into `.specs/`, and checks that nothing was lost on the way. Use when adopting this flow on a project that already has documentation, or when porting material from any other source.

name: spec-adotar-contexto
description: Traz contexto que já existe — README, ADRs, wiki, tickets, specs de outra ferramenta — para dentro do `.specs/`, e confere que nada se perdeu no caminho. Use ao adotar este fluxo num projeto que já tem documentação, ou ao portar material de qualquer outra fonte.

name: spec-adr
description: Cria um Architecture Decision Record em specs/arquitetura/adr/ ou marca um ADR existente como substituído. Use sempre que uma decisão técnica com alternativa plausível for tomada — escolha de biblioteca, padrão de persistência, estratégia de cache, modelo de autenticação, comprar vs construir, ou aceitação consciente de dívida técnica. Use também quando o usuário disser que mudou de ideia sobre uma decisão já registrada, ou pedir para documentar o porquê de algo.

name: spec-adr-builder
description: Generate or review technical specs and Architecture Decision Records. Use when the user asks for specs, ADRs, RFCs, design docs, decision records, technical requirements, non-goals, alternatives, rollout, or rollback documents. For user-research requirements elicitation use user-research.

name: spec-adr-manager
description: Create, review, and update Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) using MADR 4.x conventions and repository ADR patterns. Use when asked to document an architecture/technical decision, compare options with rationale, supersede an older ADR, or improve ADR quality.

name: spec-adversarial-audit
description: 高影響宣言（再構築レディ・監査完了・reconciliation ゼロ・保持必須契約）の独立検証（SB-12/GP-16）を、段階的縮退の最上位＝複数反証者の多数決 + completeness-critic レンズ分担 + 全体誤り率の層化無作為抽出（GP-16 ルール10）で実行し、実施記録と検証範囲の追記まで行う。レディ宣言・監査完了宣言の直前に使う。

name: spec-adversarial-review
description: Stress-test a subject spec for ambiguity, gaps, contradictions, and untestable claims using dynamic agent teams. Use this when the spec has passed completeness and synthesis-review gates and needs adversarial validation before readiness promotion.
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, Agent

name: spec-adversary
description: Interrogate a spec for ambiguity until two independent parties could build from it and their code would fit. Use when a spec, PRD or requirements document has to be precise enough to split work between people or agents, when asked to find ambiguity, holes, or unstated assumptions in a spec, when a contract or interface between two halves of a system needs pinning down, or before emitting contract tests from a spec.

name: spec-adversary
description: Adversarially probe a module's invariant documentation for missing properties. Given `docs/invariants/<module>.md` plus the module's code, proposes up to 3 candidate invariants the spec is failing to document, each annotated with evidence, category, confidence, and an accept/reject/defer triage block for human review. Layer 6 (spec completeness) search methodology — iterative, not deterministic; its findings are not evidence, and a proof of completeness is not yet reached. Triggers: "spec adversary", "what is the spec missing", "propose missing invariants", "adversarial invariant review".

name: spec-adversary

name: spec-change
description: Produce the grilled spec doc for a change and keep the documentation honest — draft docs/specs/<feature>.md, grill the human on the uncertain deltas via grill-with-docs, and update CONTEXT.md or write an ADR when a decision qualifies. name: spec-change
description: The only way docs/spec/ changes - its own branch and pull request with the exact edit, a dated line in the spec-change log, and the build-plan tasks it affects.

description: Change a rule in the spec with the owner's approval, log the change, and list the code and tests it affects. Use when the owner decides the product should behave differently from docs/spec.

name: spec-change
description: 统管需求变更的回流：把对已有特性的任何改动按「先文档后代码」的铁律同步回 PRD → 原型 → 设计 → plan，复用原 NNN、续编 R/F 与 AE/AC、不重排。Use when 客户/内部对已上线或在研特性提出改动、原型评审后要变更需求、开发中发现需求漏洞要回流。全新特性请改用 /spec-prd。

name: spec-change-governance
description: Govern spec amendments without losing history, completed work, or review context. Use when the user wants to change requirements, amend a plan, update a spec in place, mark superseded items, rerun clarification or planning, or prevent spec drift during rework.

name: spec-change-impact
description: How to change a requirement that other things already depend on: classifying the change by blast radius, finding every citation and every copied term or number before editing, judging what each downstream artifact's status costs, handling removals and renames, and routing the drift as work instead of fixing it yourself. name: spec-change-map
description: Routes project changes to the correct spec files and documents the propagation path across ERS, ADRs, CONTEXT docs, agents, and skills. Use when requirements, technology constraints, terminology, architecture decisions, or agent workflows change and you need to know what to edit.

name: spec-change-orchestrator
description: Routes a change request against an existing design spec (blueprint — architecture/domain/database/API/events; or design — tokens/system/flows) to modify (revise the spec element and ripple it into dependent code) or delete (remove the spec element and cascade-remove dependent code), and delegates to spec-modifier / spec-remover. Use when a contract changed and both the spec and the code generated from it must move together.

name: spec-change-review
description: Check skill. Every changed line of code is governed by a requirement, and changed requirements are re-verified (the SpecTrace retrieval step). Run when a requirement names this skill in its Verified by line or a change touches what it checks.

name: spec-change-walkthrough
description: Writes a verified change's closing walkthrough — what it closed, what order to review it in by risk, the decisions and the gotchas. Use only after an approved verdict and before archiving.

name: spec-changes
description: Show or record what a branch changed in each SPEC.md - section by section, the rules added, the rules changed (now and before, changed words marked) and the rules removed, with added drawings shown - as a preview in the session or as one generated file per feature per branch, plus a summary table for the pull request. Run only when a person asks for it.

name: spec-charter
description: Create, amend, or reassess spec/charter.md (project direction) and spec/system-map.md (system shape).

name: spec-chat
description: Discussion mode. Everything said during this mode is treated as thinking material only — no documents are touched. Use for brainstorming directions, or to talk through concerns about a proposal before deciding how to change it.

name: spec-check
description: Audit spec/plan documents against the codebase. Ensures every spec section has implementing code, tests, and matching logic. Use when the user says "check specs", "spec audit", or "verify specs".

name: spec-check
description: Checks a module against its spec. Produces: a pass or fail table.

name: spec-check
description: Review an implementation spec for contradictions, redundancy, and completeness. Use when asked to review or check a spec against the codebase.

name: spec-check
description: Find discrepancies between specs, code, tests, and docs, then bring them into line. Use when the user says "check specs", "spec audit", or "verify specs".

name: spec-check
description: Sharpens a feature idea, RFC, ADR or engineering plan into a falsifiable specification before code is written, and lints spec files for vague requirements, missing failure or rollback paths, broken repository paths and untraced requirement IDs. Ships a stdlib spec linter (`spec_lint.py`). Use before starting a nontrivial feature, when reviewing an RFC or design doc, when requirements sound loose or unmeasurable, or when verifying that every requirement in a spec maps to code and tests.

name: spec-check
description: Check a task against the project's specs before implementing it, and again before declaring it done. Produces the requirement table that the code-kit path guard requires before a lane writes code on a branch. Use at the start of any non-trivial task, or when checking code against the spec.

name: spec-check
description: Checks code and documentation against an authoritative specification.

name: spec-check
description: Verify specification compliance for web-exposed features (HTML, DOM, CSS, Fetch, media and other web specs) and codec/format/protocol internals
allowed_tools: Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash(printenv GECKO_AGENT_MODE), Bash(command -v *), Bash(searchfox-cli *), Bash(webspec-index *)

name: spec-check
description: Vérifie la cohérence cross-file des specs Redface 2 (noms modules, modèles, types, diagrammes, versions). Use after each specs modification to catch inconsistencies before commit.

name: spec-check
description: Audit GWT acceptance test specs for implementation leakage. Optionally provide a specific file path.

name: spec-check
description: Opt-in, read-only lint of AC-### integrity. Use when you want a traceability table from criteria to tasks, commits and tests, or to find orphan criteria and tasks. Writes nothing.

name: spec-check
description: Проверка на этапе черновика плана — есть ли под этот план или задачу раздел спеки. Прогоняет `cli spec match` по тексту плана или задачи и разводит на три ответа: раздел есть (прочитать и слинковать), раздела нет (завести или объяснить, почему не надо), раздел уже слинкован (сверить). Запускать в plan mode до ExitPlanMode, при заведении плана и по просьбам вида «есть ли спека под это», «проверь спеку по задаче», «/spec-check».

name: spec-check
description: Independent acceptance of a feature spec — checks every acceptance criterion against a real test run, gives a verdict (READY / NOT READY) and sets status implemented only on READY. Use this skill when the user wants to know whether a spec is fulfilled, or wants to close a spec after implementing it by hand.

name: spec-check
description: Keep code and its spec/doc in agreement — whether you're writing them TOGETHER for new work or auditing an EXISTING project. Find places where the code does X but the spec claims Y, and decide which side to fix, before you commit. No API key needed; runs in your coding-agent session.

name: spec-check
description: 外部規格技術可行性檢查（唯讀）。在規格治理者凍結 SPEC 之前（DRAFT）或凍結後稽核（FROZEN），從 repo、產品配置、repo memory、知識庫角度逐條檢查驗收條件可行性、隱藏影響與規格衝突，輸出固定格式報告。不改 code、不改 SPEC、不 commit、不部署、不替使用者做產品選擇。用法：/spec-check <SPEC.md 絕對路徑>

name: spec-check
description: Run the spec gates, deterministic format checks on docs/specs and docs/decisions (unique IDs, heading anchors, EARS patterns, size budgets) via an optional zero-dependency Node script, plus agent checks for scenario coverage, decision append-only and ID reuse. Use before finishing a change, in CI, or when the user asks to check, validate or lint specs.

name: spec-check
description: Verify code against a spec plan. Supports PR diff checks and full state audits.

name: spec-check
description: Use to freshly check working-tree or pull-request changes against Git ownership specs or governing Brain requirements, investigate spec drift, or verify a proposed spec correction. Also handles /memhub:spec check. Produces cited findings and explicit coverage; does not modify code or specs by default.

name: spec-check
description: Check a change against Big Calendar's specs and decisions before committing. Use before any commit that touches package code, and whenever unsure whether something is allowed.

name: spec-check
description: Audit a draft spec.md against the Socratic Definition of Done — classify every AC into one of three tiers, run the four Socratic Probes (Razor, Delegation, Story-Link, Constraint-Sourcing), and return structured audit outcomes the caller can apply. Use when the user invokes /jim:spec-check against a spec.md path, or when /jim:spec invokes the audit at Step 9 via Skill(jim:spec-check). Do not use for spec creation (/jim:spec), planning (/jim:plan), or implementation (/jim:build).

name: spec-check
description: 實作前檢查設計文件：對照真實程式碼與 DB 查一份 <spec.dir> 的設計文件能不能直接開發、驗收案例可不可測；--sample 對照實際程式碼驗設計文件覆蓋度。Use when 驗證規格、規格檢查、spec-check、dev readiness、驗證規格 vs 程式行為、規格覆蓋度。

name: spec-check
description: 自动校验本仓结构契约：三平台资产集合一致、Skill 三份逐字相同、规则正文相同、 frontmatter 合法、正文无平台前缀、相对链接可达、JSON 可解析、文档数量与实物一致。 触发：提交前、push 前、改规则 / Agent / Skill、发版、CI 红灯。

name: spec-check
description: Audit current branch for spec_v3.md drift and missing section citations

name: spec-check
description: Use to audit an implementation against its spec and set the ticket status from reality (Verified/Partial/Broken). Triggers: 'spec-check', 'is this actually implemented', 'audit ticket X'.

name: spec-check
description: Check whether code implements a specification - a PDF, Markdown or text spec in the repo, or a URL such as an RFC or API doc - requirement by requirement, with path:line evidence.

name: spec-check
description: Verify specification compliance for web-exposed features and codec/format/protocol internals

A fresh reviewer that never saw the implementer's chat compares the diff with every spec item and runs a security pass. A second agent tries to disprove each finding. Use when the user says "spec check", "check this against the spec", "review against the artifact" or…

name: spec-check
description: Check code against the business rules in the local domain documents, passively after a code review or on demand for coverage. Read-only except build. Triggers - "spec-check", "check rules", "rule coverage", "check <rule ID>", "spec-check build"; also invoked by the code-review skill.

name: spec-check
description: Re-reads the relevant spec and confirms it is in APPROVED state before any implementation begins.

name: spec-check
description: Proves the built product matches the spec: probes every acceptance criterion and every Always/Ask first/Never boundary on the running app, including AI guardrails and human approvals. Use in Build after all slices.

It runs the trace check script, explains the findings, fixes mechanical issues when asked, and with --deep spawns the spec-reviewer agent to compare implementation behaviour against the prod-doc and user-doc requirement by requirement.

name: spec-check
description: Audit GWT acceptance specs for implementation language leakage

name: spec-check
description: Verifica si una feature, cambio o tarea está en scope para la fase actual de Tuqui y si es coherente con las decisiones arquitectónicas del proyecto. Útil antes de empezar a implementar algo nuevo.

name: spec-check
description: Valida uma spec do Spec Kit contra o template do projeto (.specify/templates/spec-template.md) e diz se está pronta para /plan. Use sempre que uma spec for escrita ou revisada, ou quando o usuário pedir para avançar de /specify para /plan. Dispare mesmo sem pedido explícito.

name: spec-check
description: Unit `spec-check <N>` - Stage 0 for one phase: audit the phase's spec files against READINESS.md, turn gaps into questions for Josh, record his answers, repeat until no gaps, then Josh signs off. Interactive only; the launcher never starts it. Usage /spec-check <phase number>.

name: spec-check

Use when the user wants to check that the implementation still matches the spec, after editing any intent.md, after amending the constitution, or as a pre-PR audit. Triggers on "check for drift", "verify against intent", "does the code match the spec", "audit against constitution", "spec-check", "/spec-check".
allowed_tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, Agent

name: spec-check
description: Audit that every acceptance criterion of the current feature is covered by a passing test and matches the cited spec. Use right before running the reviewer and feature.py done.

name: spec-check
description: Audit proposed or written code against the KINGA AMR specs in docs/ — every threshold traced to a spec line, the eight hard constraints checked, and the resistance-language discipline enforced. Use before implementing a signal, model or endpoint, and after writing one.

name: spec-check
description: Review alignment between the requested feature and its actual implementation.

name: spec-check

name: spec-check
description: Validate a specification document's numbering and cross-references — duplicate or out-of-order headings and requirement IDs, orphan subsections, gaps, malformed identifiers, and dangling §/R references including citations into other specs. Use after writing or revising any spec, before handing it to anyone, and whenever a spec cites another document by name. Also use when asked to check, lint, or verify a spec, or when a spec has been renumbered, split, merged, or had sections deleted.

name: spec-check
description: Spec compliance checker. Given a spec and a branch, compares every requirement against the implementation diff with evidence. Reports per-requirement PASS/FAIL with file:line references and an overall verdict. Use standalone after any spec-driven implementation, or as the verification phase of an orchestrated pipeline.

name: spec-check
description: Checks a project's VISION, FUNCTIONAL and TECHNICAL documents (flat or with subsystems) for consistency, and writes only a findings report. Runs spec-lint, then small pairwise judgment checks J1 to J7, keeps only findings whose quotes a script finds in the files, has the other vendor confirm the severe ones, and skips tensions the human accepted. Use when the human says "/spec-check", when spec-change checks a change before showing it, when the deputy is about to sketch a slice, or after a project gains subsystems.

name: spec-check
description: Проверка по ТЗ — обязательный шаг перед словом «готово» в конце каждой задачи с правками, любого уровня (вызывается из done-check). Раскладывает ТЗ, а без него — задачу, дописки владельца, его ответы и принятый план на проверяемые пункты; у каждого пункта доказательство (файл и строка, маршрут, кадр). Поля ввода и кнопки — прогоном look.js на компьютере и телефоне: есть, видны, не перекрыты, нажимаются. Картинки и видео — каждый объект из задания. Задача «скопируй / повтори как в …» — до начала опись и вопросы владельцу кнопками, а не догадки. Итог — таблица и строка «Проверка по ТЗ: N из N»;…

name: spec-check
description: Use for every coding task that comes with a written spec, TASK.md, bug report or docstrings - implementing a function, parser, validator, data cleaner, bug fix or refactor. Checks the spec against running code before you say you are done.

name: spec-check
description: Have a fresh, read-only agent check a spec and/or its tickets for readiness before builders start: can it be paraphrased, does any ticket force a design decision, are criteria pass/fail, does it match the code, is anything reinvented. Use before /to-tickets or /multi-implement, or when the user asks to check, sanity-check or second-opinion a spec or ticket set.

name: spec-check
description: コードの実装・テスト・コメントから現在の仕様を読み取り、ユーザーが認識している仕様と比較して差分を提示するスキル。 「〇〇の仕様を教えて」「この機能はどんな動作をするの？」「自分の認識と実装が合っているか確認して」 「〇〇はXXという動作をするはず、合ってる？」「この実装は〇〇という仕様になってる？」といった依頼のときに使用する。 専用ドキュメントが無いプロジェクトでも、コードそのものが仕様であると捉え、テストや実装・コメントを読み解いて仕様を導き出す。 仕様の確認依頼、実装と認識のズレ確認、機能の動作説明依頼があれば積極的に使うこと。

name: spec-check
description: Read one whole module of the built code against its spec files and list every gap. Reports only; changes nothing.

name: spec-check
description: Compare what is built for one module with its spec files and report every gap. Reports only; changes nothing.

name: spec-check
description: Read-only readiness check of one SDD spec before planning: runs the spec-writing self-check and returns a READY or NOT READY verdict with each blocking finding and its line. Use when the user runs /sdd-engineering:spec-check <spec>, or asks 'is this spec ready for planning?' or 'check my spec'. Does NOT edit the spec or write one (use sdd-engineering:spec-creator).

name: spec-check
description: Runiverse 문서끼리 또는 문서와 구현의 불일치, 클린 아키텍처 규칙 위반을 진단한다. API·ERD 정합성, 레이어 의존 방향, 에러 노출, 포트 구조, DTO 단위를 점검한다. "명세대로 구현됐나", "스펙 누락", "문서와 코드가 맞나", "레이어·아키텍처 규칙 점검", 리뷰·PR 전 점검 같은 요청에 사용한다. 수정이 함께 요청되면 수정 전에 진단 단계로 적용하며, 이 스킬 자체는 파일을 변경하지 않는다. 일반 코드 품질 리뷰, 순수 구조 설명, 불일치 진단이 없는 문서 작성·편집에는 사용하지 않는다.

name: spec-check
description: Audit this dynamic-panel AR(1) simulation project against SPEC.md and report pass or fail for each check. Use when asked to check the project against the spec, verify the code still matches SPEC.md, or confirm the outputs are current. It reports only; it fixes nothing unless the user asks.

name: spec-check
description: Nghiệm thu code đã viết so với plan/docs của dự án — đọc checklist một mục/batch, đối chiếu code trong src/ với notes + docs, báo cáo chỗ lệch. Chỉ đọc, không sửa file, không build, không chạy app. Dùng khi user gõ /spec-check <mục|batch>, hoặc hỏi "code đúng docs chưa", "nghiệm thu mục 3", "check code với plan", "code follow plan chưa".

name: spec-check
